# Everlume Health

> Evidence-based women's health clinic in Farmington, Utah, with two providers. We publish clinician-reviewed education on symptoms, conditions, life stages, hormone therapy and prevention for women in Davis County and Northern Utah.

Clinic: Farmington, UT 84025. Virtual visits for many concerns across Utah. Free 15-minute virtual consultation.
All medical content lists an author, a medical reviewer and a last-reviewed date, and cites sources such as ACOG, The Menopause Society, USPSTF and NIH.

## Core sections
- [Symptoms](https://www.everlumehealth.com/symptoms/): what a symptom can mean, related conditions, when to seek care
- [Conditions](https://www.everlumehealth.com/conditions/): plain-language condition library with evaluation and treatment options
- [Life Stages](https://www.everlumehealth.com/life-stages/): health needs from college to care after 60
- [Solutions](https://www.everlumehealth.com/solutions/): hormone therapy, women's wellness, lifestyle medicine
- [Prevention](https://www.everlumehealth.com/prevention/): screenings and risk reduction
- [Patient Guide](https://www.everlumehealth.com/patient-guide/): question-based guidance on when to see a provider
- [Learning Center](https://www.everlumehealth.com/learning-center/): articles and medical updates
